name: OpenObserve
description: Installs OpenObserve OSS single binary and runs it as an s6-overlay service.

version.description: OpenObserve release version to install. `latest` installs the current stable release.

host.description: Interface used by OpenObserve HTTP server. `localhost` is normalized to `127.0.0.1`.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs OpenObserve. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name exposed through the Caddy Feature.

rootUserEmail.description: Initial administrator email address used to bootstrap the root user account.

rootUserPassword.description: Initial administrator password used to bootstrap the root user account.

telemetry.description: Enable or disable anonymous usage telemetry sent to upstream.

sha256.description: Optional expected SHA256 checksum for the downloaded release archive.

s3BucketPrefix.description: Optional S3 object-key prefix unique to this container. Use when several containers share one bucket. Must start with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, '.', '_', '/', or '-'; no leading '/', empty segments, commas, or spaces. After trailing slashes are stripped and one '/' is appended, at most 256 characters. Leave empty to leave ZO_S3_BUCKET_PREFIX unset.
